content.short: Trusta is a decentralized reputation and identity protocol providing AI-driven credit scoring and Sybil detection.
content.description: Trusta is a pioneering decentralized identity and reputation protocol designed to verify on-chain behavior for Web3 users and AI agents. The platform features the MEDIA Score, a comprehensive metric that assesses reputation based on Monetary value, Engagement, Diversity, Identity, and Age of the account. This allows projects to distinguish high-quality human participants from bots and Sybil attackers in a transparent manner. By utilizing advanced AI algorithms, Trusta provides developers with robust tools like TrustScan for proactive risk management and user profiling.
content.meta: Trusta provides AI-powered on-chain reputation scoring and Sybil detection tools for decentralized identity. Discover Trusta on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
